detail.title: 陆霁
detail.message: “接下来我会直接接入你的任务频道。别只看说明书——每个操作都亲手做一次，我们再进入真正的零域航道。”

checks.name: mobile-standard zh easy page 0: one tap advances exactly one page
mobile-standard zh easy page 1: dialogue, text, and Continue are in view and uncovered

detail.title: 先定义“周围格”
detail.message: 当前规则把目标格周围三层 3×3 区域里的其他格子都视为相邻：上层 9 格、同层 8 格、下层 9 格，每个坐标只计算一次。数字显示的不是格子数，而是这些位置里实际存在的雷数。

checks.name: mobile-standard zh easy page 1: one tap advances exactly one page
mobile-standard zh easy page 2: dialogue, text, and Continue are in view and uncovered

detail.title: 开始连续实操：挖掘模式
detail.message: “现在开始实操。选择底部的‘挖掘’，再轻触青色目标。青色外框是本步要打开的安全格。你每完成一步，我都会自动推理并指出下一步。”

checks.name: mobile-standard zh easy: focus leaves the dialogue when it closes
mobile-standard zh easy: after the guided action the dialogue reopens with focus inside

resumed.title: 先看清数字管哪些格
resumed.message: “数字关系开始变复杂了。长按一个已翻开的数字，它负责的所有相邻单元格就会一起亮起来。这个操作只查看范围，不会挖掘或标记。”

detail.title: Define neighboring cells
detail.message: This ruleset treats every other cube in the three 3×3 layers around a target as adjacent: 9 above, 8 on the same layer, and 9 below. Each coordinate is counted once. The number shows how many actual mines occupy those positions.

detail.title: Hands-on Sequence: Dig Mode
detail.message: “Time for the live run. Select Dig in the bottom dock, then tap the cyan target. The cyan frame marks this step’s safe cube. Each time you finish a move, I’ll automatically deduce and mark the next one.”
